title: Microsoft Purview DLP: rules to auto-resolve and tag alerts
summary: Hold: the statement that existing alert controls are manual overlooks Microsoft's documented automatic alert tuning. The roadmap details match the record, and searches found no documentation identifying the planned tagging and auto-resolution feature itself. The background licensing and Defender investigation guidance also need narrower qualifications.
